title: Living Sumi-e Scroll
summary: A 45-second Canvas 2D sumi-e scroll film where calligraphy brush strokes rise into a fighting tiger and winged dragon.
description: A 45-second hand-drawn Canvas 2D film on a silk-mounted xuan-paper scroll. A bamboo brush lays down broken inscriptions whose wet ink rises into an articulated tiger and winged dragon, collides in vermilion seal impacts and gold leaf, and settles back into a circular painting.
